title: Determine GP8 support for authored note-duration percentages
scope: Establish whether the existing DurationPercent field has a supported GP8 destination.
acceptance: Use 0.5 and 0.75 duration percentages without changing the rhythmic note value.
Find independent target-consumer support or reproduce the fixed-duration limitation.
Implement a verified mapping or retain a scoped omission and strict-policy evidence.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
target-limit: No GPIF note-duration-percentage property is retained by the pinned parser/writer; preserve explicit export loss.

Verify 0.5 and 0.75 legacy DurationPercent values survive public import and are explicitly reported by gp8.omit.note-duration-percent during export. Check strict rejection and preserve rhythmic duration, ties and let-ring behavior unchanged. Cite existing tests or add the missing exact assertions. Resolve as a target limit when the acceptance checklist passes. Reopen implementation only for a dedicated authored GP7/GP8 record retained by a second consumer, not a timing approximation.
